readings.title: The Glory Departs the Temple
readings.subtitle: Coals of fire are scattered over the city as the cherubim prepare to leave.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 10:1] And <dn>I</dn> looked and saw in the expanse that was above the head of the keruḇim, like a sapphire stone, having the appearance of the likeness of a throne. [2] And <dn>He</dn> spoke to the man clothed with linen, and said, <dq>“Go in among the wheels, under the keruḇ, and fill your hands with coals of fire from among the keruḇim, and scatter over the city.”</dq> And he went in before <dn>my</dn> eyes. [3] And the keruḇim were standing on the south side of the House when the man went in, and the cloud filled the inner court. [4] And the esteem of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> went up from the keruḇ, over the threshold of the House. And the House was filled with the cloud, and the court was filled with the brightness of the esteem of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [5] And the sound of the wings of the keruḇim was heard in the outer court, like the voice of Ěl Shaddai when <dn>He</dn> speaks. [6] And it came to be, when <dn>He</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> the man clothed in linen, saying, <dq>“Take fire from among the wheels, from among the keruḇim,”</dq> that he went in and stood beside the wheel. [7] And the keruḇ stretched out his hand from among the keruḇim to the fire that was among the keruḇim, and took some, and put it into the hands of the man clothed with linen, who took it and went out. [8] And the form of a man’s hand was seen under the wings of the keruḇim. [9] And <dn>I</dn> looked and saw four wheels beside the keruḇim, one wheel beside each keruḇ, and the wheels’ appearance was like the colour of beryl stone. [10] As for their appearance, all four looked alike; as if a wheel in the middle of a wheel. [11] When they went, they went on their four sides; they did not turn aside when they went, but went in the direction the head was facing. They did not turn aside when they went. [12] And their entire bodies, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels that the four had, were covered with eyes all around. [13] The wheels were called in <dn>my</dn> hearing, “Wheel.” [14] And each one had four faces: the first face was the face of a keruḇ, and the second face the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle. [15] And the keruḇim were lifted up – it was the living creature <dn>I</dn> saw by the River Keḇar. [16] And when the keruḇim went the wheels went beside them. And when the keruḇim lifted their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also did not turn from beside them. [17] When they stood still, the wheels stood still, and when one was lifted up, the other lifted itself up, for the spirit of the living creature was in them. [18] And the esteem of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> went from the threshold of the House and stood over the keruḇim. [19] And the keruḇim lifted their wings and rose from the earth before <dn>my</dn> eyes. When they went out, the wheels were beside them. And it stood at the door of the east gate of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and the esteem of the <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ěl was above them. [20] It was the living creature <dn>I</dn> saw under the <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ěl by the River Keḇar, and <dn>I</dn> knew they were keruḇim. [21] Each one had four faces and each one four wings, and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings. [22] And the likeness of their faces was the same as the faces which <dn>I</dn> had seen by the River Keḇar, their appearances and themselves. Each one went straight forward.

readings.title: Judgment on the Wicked Leaders
readings.subtitle: The proverb of the cooking pot is refuted, and Pelatyahu dies as a sign.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 11:1] And the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, which faces east. And see, at the door of the gate were twenty-five men, among whom <dn>I</dn> saw Ya‛azanyah son of Azzur, and Pelatyahu son of Benayahu, heads of the people. [2] And <dn>He</dn> said to me, <dq>“Son of man, these are the men who plot wickedness and give evil counsel in this city,</dq> [3] <dq>who are saying, ‘It is not near, let us build houses. This city is the cooking pot, and we are the meat.’</dq> [4] <dq>“Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man!”</dq> [5] And the Spirit of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> fell upon me, and said to me, <dq>“Speak! ‘Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “Thus you have said, O house of Yisra’ěl. For <dn>I</dn> know what comes up in your spirit.</dq> [6] <dq>“You have increased your slain in this city, and filled its streets with the slain.”</dq> [7] <dq>Therefore thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “Your slain whom you have laid in its midst, they are the meat, and this city is the cooking pot. But <dn>I</dn> shall bring <dn>את</dn> you out of the midst of it.</dq> [8] <dq>“You have feared the sword, and <dn>I</dn> bring a sword upon you,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [9] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall bring <dn>את</dn> you out of its midst, and give <dn>את</dn> you into the hands of strangers, and execute judgments on you.</dq> [10] <dq>“By the sword you fall. At the border of Yisra’ěl <dn>I</dn> judge <dn>את</dn> you. And you shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [11] <dq>“This city is not your cooking pot, nor are you the meat in its midst. At the border of Yisra’ěl <dn>I</dn> judge you.</dq> [12] <dq>“And you shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, for you have not walked in <dn>My</dn> laws nor executed <dn>My</dn> right-rulings, but have done according to the rulings of the nations which are all around you.” ’ ”</dq> [13] And it came to be, while <dn>I</dn> was prophesying, that Pelatyahu son of Benayah died. And <dn>I</dn> fell on <dn>my</dn> face and cried out with a loud voice, and said, “Ah, Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! Are <dn>You</dn> making an end of <dn>את</dn> the remnant of Yisra’ěl?”

readings.title: A Promise of Restoration
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH promises to gather the exiles and give them a new heart.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 11:14] Then the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying, [15] <dq>“Son of man, your brothers, <dn>את</dn> your relatives, your kinsmen, and all the house of Yisra’ěl, all of it, are those about whom the inhabitants of Yerushalayim said, ‘Keep far from <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, this land has been given to us as a possession.’</dq> [16] <dq>“Therefore say, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “Although <dn>I</dn> have sent them far off among the nations, and although <dn>I</dn> have scattered them among the lands, yet <dn>I</dn> was for them a set-apart place for a little while in the lands to which they came.” ’</dq> [17] <dq>“Therefore say, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “And <dn>I</dn> shall gather <dn>את</dn> you from the peoples, and <dn>I</dn> shall assemble <dn>את</dn> you from the lands where you have been scattered, and <dn>I</dn> shall give you <dn>את</dn> the land of Yisra’ěl.” ’</dq> [18] <dq>“And they shall go there, and shall take away <dn>את</dn> all its disgusting matters and <dn>את</dn> all its abominations from there.</dq> [19] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall give them one heart, and put a new spirit within you. And <dn>I</dn> shall take <dn>את</dn> the stony heart out of their flesh, and give them a heart of flesh,</dq> [20] <dq>so that they walk in <dn>My</dn> laws, and guard <dn>My</dn> right-rulings, and shall do them. And they shall be <dn>My</dn> people and <dn>I</dn> shall be their <dn>Elohim</dn>.</dq> [21] <dq>“But to those whose hearts walk after the heart of their disgusting matters and their abominations, <dn>I</dn> shall recompense their deeds on their own heads,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: The Glory Leaves Jerusalem
readings.subtitle: The vision concludes as the esteem of YeHoVaH departs from the city and Ezekiel reports to the exiles.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 11:22] And the keruḇim lifted up their wings, with the wheels beside them, and the esteem of the <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ěl was high above them. [23] And the esteem of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> went up from the midst of the city and stood upon the mountain, which is on the east side of the city. [24] And the Spirit lifted me up and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of <dn>Elohim</dn> into Kasdima, to those in exile. And the vision that <dn>I</dn> had seen went up from me. [25] And <dn>I</dn> spoke to those in exile of all the words of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> which <dn>He</dn> had shown me.

readings.title: Ezekiel Portrays the Exile
readings.subtitle: Through symbolic actions, the prophet demonstrates the coming captivity of Jerusalem and its prince.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 12:1] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying, [2] <dq>“Son of man, you are dwelling in the midst of a rebellious house. They have eyes to see but they have not seen, they have ears to hear but they have not heard, for they are a rebellious house.</dq> [3] <dq>“Therefore, son of man, prepare your baggage for exile, and go into exile by day before their eyes. And you shall go from your place into exile to another place before their eyes. It could be that they see, though they are a rebellious house.</dq> [4] <dq>“And you shall bring out your baggage for exile before their eyes by day, and at evening go before their eyes, like those who go into exile.</dq> [5] <dq>“Dig through the wall before their eyes, and you shall bring them out through it –</dq> [6] <dq>take them on your shoulders and bring them out at dark before their eyes. Cover your face, so that you do not see <dn>את</dn> the land, for <dn>I</dn> have made you a sign to the house of Yisra’ěl.”</dq> [7] And so <dn>I</dn> did, as <dn>I</dn> was commanded. <dn>I</dn> brought out <dn>my</dn> baggage for exile by day, and at evening <dn>I</dn> dug through the wall with <dn>my</dn> hand. <dn>I</dn> brought them out at dark, and <dn>I</dn> took them on <dn>my</dn> shoulder before their eyes. [8] And in the morning the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying, [9] <dq>“Son of man, did not the house of Yisra’ěl, the rebellious house, say to you, ‘What are you doing?’</dq> [10] <dq>“Say to them, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “This message is to the prince in Yerushalayim and all the house of Yisra’ěl who are in their midst.” ’</dq> [11] <dq>“Say, ‘<dn>I</dn> am a sign to you. As <dn>I</dn> have done, so it is done to them – they are to go into exile, into captivity.’</dq> [12] <dq>“And the prince who is in their midst is to bear his baggage on his shoulder at dark and go out. They are to dig through the wall to bring them out through it. <dn>He</dn> is to cover his face, so that he does not see the land with his eyes.</dq> [13] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall spread <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> net over him, and he shall be caught in <dn>My</dn> snare. And <dn>I</dn> shall bring him to Baḇel, the land of the Kasdim, but he shall not see <dn>את</dn> it, and yet die there.</dq> [14] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall scatter to every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands, and <dn>I</dn> shall draw out the sword after them.</dq> [15] <dq>“And they shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, when <dn>I</dn> scatter them among the nations. And <dn>I</dn> shall disperse them throughout the lands.</dq> [16] <dq>“But <dn>I</dn> shall let a few of their men escape from the sword, from scarcity of food, and from pestilence, so that they recount all their abominations among the nations wherever they go. And they shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.”</dq> [17] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying, [18] <dq>“Son of man, eat your bread with trembling, and drink your water with fear and with anxiety.</dq> [19] <dq>“And you shall say to the people of the land, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to the inhabitants of Yerushalayim and to the land of Yisra’ěl, “Let them eat their bread with anxiety, and drink their water with astonishment, for her land is emptied of all who are in it, because of the violence of all those who dwell in it.</dq> [20] <dq>“And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall become a wasteland. And you shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.” ’ ”</dq>

readings.title: The Imminence of Judgment
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH refutes the proverbs of delay, declaring that His word will be performed without deferment.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 12:21] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying, [22] <dq>“Son of man, what is this proverb that you people have about the land of Yisra’ěl, which says, ‘The days go by, and every vision shall come to naught’?</dq> [23] <dq>“Therefore say to them, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “<dn>I</dn> shall make <dn>את</dn> this proverb to cease, so that they no longer use it as a proverb in Yisra’ěl.” But say to them, “The days have drawn near, as well as the matter of every vision.</dq> [24] <dq>“For no longer is there to be any false vision or flattering divination within the house of Yisra’ěl.</dq> [25] <dq>“For <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>I</dn> speak. And the word which <dn>I</dn> speak is done. It is no longer deferred. For in your days, O rebellious house, when <dn>I</dn> speak the word <dn>I</dn> shall do it,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.’ ” [26] Again the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying, [27] <dq>“Son of man, see, the house of Yisra’ěl is saying, ‘The vision that he is seeing is for many days from now, and he is prophesying of times far off.’</dq> [28] <dq>“Therefore say to them, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “None of <dn>My</dn> words are deferred any longer. When <dn>I</dn> speak a word it is done,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.’ ”

readings.title: Woe to the False Prophets
readings.subtitle: They are condemned for prophesying peace from their own hearts and building a wall coated with whitewash.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 13:1] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying, [2] <dq>“Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Yisra’ěl who prophesy, and say to those who prophesy out of their own heart, ‘Hear the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>!’ ”</dq> [3] Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“Woe to the foolish prophets, who are following their own spirit, without having had a vision!</dq> [4] <dq>“O Yisra’ěl, your prophets have been like foxes among ruins.</dq> [5] <dq>“You have not gone up into the breaches, nor do you build a wall for the house of Yisra’ěl to stand in battle on the day of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [6] <dq>“Their visions are false and their divinations a lie, saying, ‘Thus declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>,’ when <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has not sent them, yet they expected the word to be confirmed!</dq> [7] <dq>“Have you not seen a false vision, and have you not spoken a divination of lies? You say, ‘<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> declares,’ when <dn>I</dn> have not spoken.”</dq> [8] Therefore thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“Because you have spoken falsehood and seen lies, therefore see, <dn>I</dn> am against you,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [9] <dq>“<dn>My</dn> hand shall be against the prophets who see falsehood and who divine lies. They shall not be in the council of <dn>My</dn> people, nor be written in the record of the house of Yisra’ěl, and they shall not enter into the land of Yisra’ěl. And you shall know that <dn>I</dn> am the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [10] <dq>“Because, yes because they have led <dn>My</dn> people astray, saying, ‘Peace!’ when there is no peace. And when one is building a wall, see, they are coating <dn>את</dn> it with whitewash!</dq> [11] <dq>“Say to those who coat it with whitewash: it shall fall! There shall be flooding rain, and you, O great hailstones: fall! – and a stormy wind breaks it down,</dq> [12] <dq>and see, the wall shall fall! Shall you not be asked, ‘Where is the coating with which you coated it?’ ”</dq> [13] Therefore thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“<dn>I</dn> shall break down with a stormy wind in <dn>My</dn> wrath, and a flooding rain in <dn>My</dn> displeasure, and great hailstones in wrath, to consume.</dq> [14] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall throw down <dn>את</dn> the wall you have coated with whitewash, and bring it down to the ground, and its foundation shall be uncovered. And it shall fall, and you shall be consumed in the midst of it. And you shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [15] <dq>“So <dn>I</dn> shall complete <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> wrath on the wall and on those coating <dn>את</dn> it with whitewash, and say to you, ‘The wall is no more, nor those whitewashing it –</dq> [16] <dq>the prophets of Yisra’ěl who are prophesying concerning Yerushalayim, and who are seeing visions of peace for her when there is no peace,’ ”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: Judgment on the Prophetesses
readings.subtitle: They are condemned for hunting souls with magic charms and lying to the people.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 13:17] <dq>“And you, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who are prophesying out of their own heart, and prophesy against them.</dq> [18] <dq>“And you shall say, ‘This is what the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said, “Woe to the women sewing cushions for all joints of the hand, and to those making veils for the heads of people of every size, to hunt beings! You hunt the beings of <dn>My</dn> people, while you keep alive your own beings!</dq> [19] <dq>“And you have profaned <dn>את</dn> <dn>Me</dn> among <dn>My</dn> people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to put to death beings that should not die, and to keep alive beings who should not live, by your lying to <dn>My</dn> people who listen to lies!”</dq> [20] <dq>Therefore thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “See, <dn>I</dn> am against your cushions by which you hunt the beings there like birds. And <dn>I</dn> shall tear <dn>את</dn> them from your arms, and shall let <dn>את</dn> the beings go, the beings you hunt like birds.</dq> [21] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall tear off <dn>את</dn> your veils, and shall deliver <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> people out of your hand, and they shall no longer be as prey in your hand. And you shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.” ’ ”</dq> [22] <dq>“Because with falsehood you have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom <dn>I</dn> have not made sad. And you have strengthened the hands of the wrong, so that he does not turn from his evil way, to keep him alive.</dq> [23] <dq>“Therefore you shall no longer see false visions, nor practise divination. And <dn>I</dn> shall deliver <dn>My</dn> people out of your hand, and you shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.” ’ ”</dq>
